**What happened** — including the input you gave (redact anything private). If a gate
passed something it should have refused (or refused something it should have passed),
that's exactly the kind of bug we want.

**What you expected.**

**Where you run it** — Claude Code plugin (`claude plugin list` version), skills copied
into `.claude/skills/`, or pasted into a Claude Project.
